title: constraints.json: why the last design failed
description: The loop between the two workflows. When pathing finds no route (route.json feasible=false) or the contact run fails (verdict.json), the agent turns the reason into a constraint on design_spec and runs the design again. Append-only across iterations. Written by A (agent). Read by A (agent.design) and B (composer.check).

reason.description: One sentence a person can read.

field.description: JSON Pointer into requirements.json this tightens.

evidence.description: The failing file is archived when the next iteration starts, at iterations/<n>/ inside the run folder.
